text_en: Then Moses and the Israelites sang this song to the Lord : “I will sing to the Lord , for he has triumphed gloriously; horse and rider he has thrown into the sea.
text_cn: 那时梅瑟和以色列子民唱了这篇诗歌， 歌颂上主说： 我要歌颂上主，因他获得全胜，将马和骑士投于海中。

text_en: The Lord is my strength and my might, and he has become my salvation; this is my God, and I will praise him, my father’s God, and I will exalt him.
text_cn: 上主是我的力量和保障，他作了我的救援。他是我的天主，我要颂扬他；是我祖先的天主，我要赞美他。

text_en: The Lord is a warrior; the Lord is his name.
text_cn: 上主是战士，名叫"雅威"。

text_en: “Pharaoh’s chariots and his army he cast into the sea; his picked officers were sunk in the Red Sea.
text_cn: 法郎的战车军队，他投于海中，使他的良将沉于红海。

text_en: The floods covered them; they went down into the depths like a stone.
text_cn: 浪涛淹没了他们，像大石沉入海底。

text_en: Your right hand, O Lord , glorious in power— your right hand, O Lord , shattered the enemy.
text_cn: 上主，你的右手大显神能；上主，你的右手击碎了敌人。

text_en: In the greatness of your majesty you overthrew your adversaries; you sent out your fury, it consumed them like stubble.
text_cn: 以你无比的威严，毁灭了你的敌人；你发出的怒火，烧灭他们像烧麦秸。

text_en: At the blast of your nostrils the waters piled up, the floods stood up in a heap; the deeps congealed in the heart of the sea.
text_cn: 你鼻孔一喷气，大水聚集，浪涛直立如堤，深渊凝固于海心。

text_en: The enemy said, ‘I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide the spoil, my desire shall have its fill of them. I will draw my sword, my hand shall destroy them. ’
text_cn: 仇人说：“我要追击擒获，分得猎物，才心满意足；我要拔刀出鞘，亲手斩灭。”

text_en: You blew with your wind, the sea covered them; they sank like lead in the mighty waters.
text_cn: 但你一嘘气，海将他们覆没，像铅沉入深渊。

text_en: “Who is like you, O Lord , among the gods? Who is like you, majestic in holiness, awesome in splendor, doing wonders?
text_cn: 上主，众神谁可与你相比？谁能像你那样，神圣尊威，光荣可畏，施行奇迹！

text_en: You stretched out your right hand, the earth swallowed them.
text_cn: 你伸出右手，大地就吞了他们；

text_en: “In your steadfast love you led the people whom you redeemed; you guided them by your strength to your holy abode.
text_cn: 以你的慈爱，领出了你所救的百姓；凭你的能力，领他们进入了你的圣所。

text_en: The peoples heard, they trembled; pangs seized the inhabitants of Philistia.
text_cn: 外邦听了，必惊慌战栗，恐怖笼罩了培肋舍特居民；

text_en: Then the chiefs of Edom were dismayed; trembling seized the leaders of Moab; all the inhabitants of Canaan melted away.
text_cn: 那时厄东的酋长惊惶失措，摩阿布的首领吓得发抖，客纳罕的居民胆战心寒。

text_en: Terror and dread fell upon them; by the might of your arm, they became still as a stone until your people, O Lord , passed by, until the people whom you acquired passed by.
text_cn: 惊慌与恐怖降在他们身上；因你大能的手臂，他们像石块僵立不动，直到你的百姓走过，上主！直到你所救赎的百姓走过。

text_en: You brought them in and planted them on the mountain of your own possession, the place, O Lord , that you made your abode, the sanctuary, O Lord , that your hands have established.
text_cn: 上主，你引领他们，吾主，在你为物业的山上，在你为自己准备的住所，在你亲手建立的圣所，培植了他们。

text_en: The Lord will reign forever and ever. ”
text_cn: 上主为王，万世无疆！

text_en: When the horses of Pharaoh with his chariots and his chariot drivers went into the sea, the Lord brought back the waters of the sea upon them; but the Israelites walked through the sea on dry ground.
text_cn: 法郎的马、战车和骑兵一到海中，上主就使海水回流，淹没了他们；以色列子民却在海中干地上走过。

text_en: Then the prophet Miriam, Aaron’s sister, took a tambourine in her hand; and all the women went out after her with tambourines and with dancing.
text_cn: 此时亚郎的姊妹女先知米黎盎手中拿着鼓，众妇女也都跟着她，拿着鼓舞蹈。

text_en: And Miriam sang to them: “Sing to the Lord , for he has triumphed gloriously; horse and rider he has thrown into the sea. ”
text_cn: 米黎盎应和他们说：“你们应歌颂上主，因他获得全胜，将马和骑士投入海中。”

text_en: Then Moses ordered Israel to set out from the Red Sea, and they went into the wilderness of Shur. They went three days in the wilderness and found no water.
text_cn: 以后梅瑟命以色列人由红海起营，往叔尔旷野去；他们在旷野里走了三天，没有找到水。

text_en: When they came to Marah, they could not drink the water of Marah because it was bitter. That is why it was called Marah.
text_cn: 随后，到了玛辣，但不能喝玛辣的水，因为水苦；因此称那地为玛辣。

text_en: And the people complained against Moses, saying, “What shall we drink? ”
text_cn: 那时百姓抱怨梅瑟说：“我们喝什么呢？”

text_en: He cried out to the Lord ; and the Lord showed him a piece of wood; he threw it into the water, and the water became sweet. There the Lord made for them a statute and an ordinance and there he put them to the test.
text_cn: 梅瑟遂呼号上主，上主便指给他一块木头；他把木头扔在水里，水就变成甜水。 上主在那里给百姓立定了法律和典章，也在那里试探了他们。

text_en: He said, “If you will listen carefully to the voice of the Lord your God, and do what is right in his sight, and give heed to his commandments and keep all his statutes, I will not bring upon you any of the diseases that I brought upon the Egyptians; for I am the Lord who heals you. ”
text_cn: 上主说：“你若诚心听从上主你天主的话，行他眼中视为正义的事，服从他的命令，遵守他的一切法律，我决不把加于埃及人的灾殃，加于你们，因为我是医治你的上主。”

text_en: Then they came to Elim, where there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees; and they camped there by the water.
text_cn: 以后他们到了厄林，那里有十二股水泉，七十棵棕树。他们便在那里靠近水边安了营。
